post.description: Requires local control.maintenance.write. Selects an exact accepted feed identity and version, downloads bounded bytes, checks trusted redirect targets, size/hash, actual build profile and frozen manifest/store binding, then accepts a pending operation. Does not replace the running Host or execute the candidate. Exact accepted replay returns the original operation; changed input with the same identity conflicts. CLI: maintenance-prepare --input <json>. Not exposed through MCP.

202.description: Prepared pending operation; not an update success receipt

409.description: Identity, resource, release trust, candidate or runtime conflict
